f this.mods.listeners ?? []) w.on(l);
        this.mods.onWorld?.(w, run);
        w.enterFloor(stage.firstFloor(run));
        this.world = w;
        this.runStage = stage;
        this.inHub = true;
        this.paused = false;
        this.scene = this.battleScene(w);
        this.mods.onPlay?.();
      }
      this.mods.onScene?.("hq");
    }
    idleScene(name) {
      return {
        name,
        tick: () => {
        },
        draw: () => {
          this.ctx.fillStyle = "#05080a";
          this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
          this.mods.drawIdle?.(name, this.ctx, performance.now() / 1e3);
        }
      };
    }
    /* ───────── 출동 ───────── */
    deploy(run, saved) {
      const stage = this.mods.stages.find((s2) => s2.id === run.stageId) ?? this.mods.stages[0];
      run = { ...run, stageId: stage.id };
      this.inHub = false;
      this.run = run;
      this.runStage = stage;
      if (this.hqRoot) this.hqRoot.hidden = true;
      this.canvas.style.visibility = "";
      const w = new World(run, this.art.clips, stage, this.mods.enemyFactory);
      if (this.mods.itemUse) w.itemUse = this.mods.itemUse;
      for (const l of this.mods.listeners ?? []) w.on(l);
      this.mods.onWorld?.(w, run);
      w.enterFloor(saved && stage.restore ? stage.restore(saved.stage) : stage.firstFloor(run));
      if (saved) w.restore(saved.world);
      this.world = w;
      this.paused = false;
      this.scene = this.battleScene(w);
      this.mods.onPlay?.();
      this.mods.onScene?.("battle");
      this.checkpoint(true);
    }
    /** 전투 도중에는 직전 안전 지점을 유지한다. HP·탄·드랍도 함께 되돌린다. */
    checkpoint(force = false) {
      const w = this.world;
      if (!w || this.inHub || !this.run || !w.canCheckpoint() || !force && this.mods.blocking?.()) return;
      const stage = this.runStage?.snapshot?.();
      if (!stage) return;
      this.mods.saveCheckpoint?.({ version: 1, run: this.run, stage, world: w.snapshot(), savedAt: Date.now() });
    }
    async resume(saved) {
      const stageId = saved.run.stageId ?? this.mods.stages[0]?.id;
      if (saved.version !== 1 || !this.mods.stages.some((s2) => s2.id === stageId && s2.restore)) throw new Error("지원하지 않는 출동 저장");
      if (this.mods.hq) {
        this.showHq();
        await this.mods.hq.ready?.();
      }
      this.deploy({ ...saved.run, stageId }, saved);
      this.world?.say("출동 복원 완료. 전투 중 중단한 경우 마지막 안전 지점부터 이어집니다.", 4);
    }
    /** 출동 끝내기 (철수 메뉴 등에서도 부른다) */
    endRun(how) {
      const w = this.world;
      if (!w || this.inHub) return;
      const result = {
        how,
        floors: Number(w.notes["stage.visitedCount"] ?? w.floors),
        kills: w.kills,
        maxCombo: w.player.maxCombo,
        timeSec: Math.round(w.tick / TICK_HZ),
        hpLeft: Math.max(0, Math.round(w.player.hp)),
        notes: w.notes
      };
      w.emit({ type: "run:end", how });
      this.lastResult = result;
      this.world = null;
      this.paused = false;
      if (this.mods.hq && this.run) {
        const run = this.run;
        this.mods.hq.onReturn(this.mods.toHqResult?.(result, w) ?? result, run);
        this.mods.saveCheckpoint?.(null);
        const back = () => this.showHq();
        if (this.mods.afterRun) {
          this.scene = this.idleScene("cutscene");
          this.mods.afterRun(how, back);
        } else back();
        return;
      }
      this.mods.saveCheckpoint?.(null);
      this.scene = this.resultScene(result);
      this.mods.onScene?.("result");
    }
    battleScene(w) {
      const ownMenu = !this.mods.paused;
      return {
        name: "battle",
        tick: (p) => {
          if (ownMenu && p.pressed.has("pause")) {
            this.paused = !this.paused;
            this.menuIndex = 0;
          }
          if (this.paused) return this.pauseMenu(p, w);
          if (this.inHub && this.hqRoot) {
            const open = !!this.mods.hq?.isOpen?.();
            this.hqRoot.hidden = !open;
            if (open) return;
          }
          if (this.mods.blocking?.() || this.mods.frozen?.()) return;
          w.step(p);
          if (w.ended) {
            const how = w.ended;
            if (how === "next") {
              const next = this.runStage.nextFloor(this.run, w.floor, "next");
              if (next) {
                w.enterFloor(next);
                this.checkpoint(true);
              } else this.endRun("return");
            } else this.endRun(how);
          } else if (w.tick % 60 === 0) this.checkpoint();
        },
        draw: (a) => {
          this.renderer.draw(w, this.paused || this.mods.blocking?.() || this.mods.hq?.isOpen?.() ? 1 : a);
          if (this.paused) this.drawMenu("일시정지", ["계속", w.showBoxes ? "판정 보기 끄기" : "판정 보기 켜기", "철수 (출동 끝내기)", "처음으로"]);
        }
      };
    }
    pauseMenu(p, w) {
      const n = 4;
      if (p.pressed.has("up")) this.menuIndex = (this.menuIndex + n - 1) % n;
      if (p.pressed.has("down")) this.menuIndex = (this.menuIndex + 1) % n;
      if (p.pressed.has("attack") || p.pressed.has("jump") || p.pressed.has("interact")) this.pick(this.menuIndex, w);
    }
    pick(i, w) {
      this.paused = false;
      if (i === 1) w.showBoxes = !w.showBoxes;
      else if (i === 2) this.endRun("withdraw");
      else if (i === 3) this.toTitle();
    }
    drawMenu(title2, items, bg = true) {
      const c = this.ctx;
      if (bg) {
        c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
        c.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
        c.fillStyle = "#e8eef0";
        c.textAlign = "center";
        c.font = pfont(44).f;
        c.fillText(title2, SCREEN_W / 2, 210);
      }
      c.textAlign = "center";
      c.font = pfont(30).f;
      items.forEach((t, i) => {
        const y = 300 + i * 64;
        c.fillStyle = i === this.menuIndex ? "#ffd36a" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)";
        c.fillRect(SCREEN_W / 2 - 230, y - 40, 460, 54);
        c.fillStyle = i === this.menuIndex ? "#1a1f22" : "#e8eef0";
        c.fillText(t, SCREEN_W / 2, y - 3);
      });
      c.textAlign = "left";
      this.menuItems = items.map((_, i) => ({ y0: 300 + i * 64 - 40, y1: 300 + i * 64 + 14 }));
    }
    onPointer(e) {
      const r = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * SCREEN_W;
      const y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * SCREEN_H;
      if (this.scene.name === "result") return this.leaveResult();
      if (Math.abs(x - SCREEN_W / 2) > 230) return;
      const i = this.menuItems.findIndex((m) => y >= m.y0 && y <= m.y1);
      if (i < 0) return;
      if (this.world && this.paused) this.pick(i, this.world);
      else if (this.scene.name === "title") this.titlePick(i);
    }
    /* ───────── 엔진 기본 제목·정산 ───────── */
    titlePick(i) {
      if (i === 0) this.start_new();
      else this.start_new(i === 1 && this.mods.hq ? this.mods.stages[0].id : "dummy");
    }
    titleScene() {
      this.menuIndex = 0;
      this.menuItems = [];
      const first = this.mods.stages[0];
      this.titleItems = this.mods.hq ? ["본부로 출근", `바로 출동 · ${first?.label ?? ""}`, "허수아비 연습"] : [`출동 · ${first?.label ?? ""}`, "허수아비 연습"];
      return {
        name: "title",
        tick: (p) => {
          const n = this.titleItems.length;
          if (p.pressed.has("up")) this.menuIndex = (this.menuIndex + n - 1) % n;
          if (p.pressed.has("down")) this.menuIndex = (this.menuIndex + 1) % n;
          if (p.pressed.has("attack") || p.pressed.has("jump") || p.pressed.has("interact")) this.titlePick(this.menuIndex);
        },
        draw: () => {
          const c = this.ctx;
          c.fillStyle = "#0d1114";
          c.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
          c.textAlign = "center";
          c.font = "bold 30px monospace";
          c.fillStyle = "#8e9aa1";
          c.fillText("ANOMALY SIMULATION", SCREEN_W / 2, 120);
          c.font = pfont(58).f;
          c.fillStyle = "#e8eef0";
          c.fillText("관리국 · 차원 승강기", SCREEN_W / 2, 190);
          this.drawMenu("", this.titleItems, false);
          c.fillStyle = "#8e9aa1";
          c.font = pfont(20).f;
          c.textAlign = "center";
          const help = [
            "방향키 이동 · A 3연타 · 달리며 A 돌진 · ↓↓ 앉기, 앉아 A 하단 · Space 점프, 공중 A 점프 킥",
            "S 권총(탄창 8, R 재장전) · D 폭파 · Q 가드 · W 필살기 · Shift 짧게 회피 / 길게 달리기",
            "경직된 적에게 걸어 붙으면 잡기 → A 무릎, 방향+A 잡기 폭파, Space 놓기 · 1~4 아이템 · H 판정 보기 · Esc 메뉴"
          ];
          help.forEach((h, i) => c.fillText(h, SCREEN_W / 2, 560 + i * 34));
          c.textAlign = "left";
        }
      };
    }
    leaveResult() {
      if (this.mods.hq) this.showHq();
      else this.toTitle();
    }
    resultScene(r) {
      this.menuIndex = 0;
      this.menuItems = [];
      const how = { return: "귀환", withdraw: "철수", evac: "후송" }[r.how];
      let t = 0;
      return {
        name: "result",
        tick: (p) => {
          if (++t > 20 && (p.pressed.has("attack") || p.pressed.has("jump") || p.pressed.has("interact") || p.pressed.has("pause"))) this.leaveResult();
        },
        draw: () => {
          const c = this.ctx;
          c.fillStyle = "#0d1114";
          c.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
          c.textAlign = "center";
          c.fillStyle = r.how === "evac" ? "#ff6a5a" : "#7fe0a0";
          c.font = pfont(64).f;
          c.fillText(how, SCREEN_W / 2, 200);
          c.fillStyle = "#e8eef0";
          c.font = pfont(30).f;
          const lines3 = [`처치 ${r.kills}`, `최대 콤보 ${r.maxCombo}`, `층 ${r.floors}`, `시간 ${r.timeSec}초`, `남은 체력 ${r.hpLeft}`];
          lines3.forEach((l, i) => c.fillText(l, SCREEN_W / 2, 290 + i * 48));
          c.fillStyle = "#8e9aa1";
          c.font = pfont(22).f;
          c.fillText("A 또는 화면을 누르면 처음으로", SCREEN_W / 2, 600);
          c.textAlign = "left";
        }
      };
    }
  };

  // src/core/fieldclock.ts
  function clockText(sec) {
    const m = Math.floor(Math.max(0, sec) / 60) % 1440;
    return `${String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  // src/core/fieldfollow.ts
  var FOLLOW = /(따라\s*와|따라\s*오|같이\s*가|같이\s*가자|함께\s*가|따라\s*다녀)/;
  var WAIT = /(기다려|여기\s*있어|여기서\s*기다|거기\s*있어|대기해)/;
  var RETURN = /(돌아가|돌아가\s*있어|복귀해|원래\s*자리)/;
  function classify(text2) {
    const t = text2.replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    if (/(따라\s*오지\s*마|따라오지\s*마|오지\s*마)/.test(t)) return "wait";
    if (WAIT.test(t)) return "wait";
    if (RETURN.test(t)) return "return";
    if (FOLLOW.test(t) && !/\?|까요|할래|하겠/.test(t)) return "follow";
    return null;
  }
  var MAX_FOLLOWERS = 4;
  function fieldCompanions(all) {
    const seen2 = [...new Set(all.map((s2) => s2.trim()).filter(Boolean))];
    return { shown: seen2.slice(0, MAX_FOLLOWERS), rest: seen2.slice(MAX_FOLLOWERS) };
  }
  function canJoin(o) {
    if (/작전\s*투입|부상|중상|격리|실종|사망/.test(o.state ?? "")) return { ok: false, reason: "지금 상태로는 따라갈 수 없어요." };
    if (o.busy) return { ok: false, reason: "지금은 맡은 일이 있어요." };
    if (o.affinity < -10) return { ok: false, reason: "선뜻 따라나서고 싶지 않은 눈치예요." };
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // src/game/talk.ts
  var FONT2 = (px) => `${px}px "${PIXEL_FONT}", "Galmuri11", sans-serif`;
  var REACH = 150;
  var BUBBLE_W = 340;
  var OVERHEAR = 480;
  var CSS2 = `
.gt-bar{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:10px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(92%,720px);display:none;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:2px 4px;pointer-events:auto;z-index:46;color:#ece6d4}
.gt-bar.gk-panel,.gt-log.gk-panel{border-width:17px;border-image-width:17px;box-shadow:none!important}
.gt-bar[data-open]{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.gt-to{font-size:18px;color:#ffe27a;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000}
.gt-in{flex:1;min-width:120px;font:inherit;font-size:20px;padding:2px 6px;background:none;color:#fff;outline:none;border-width:7px;border-image-width:7px;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000}
.gt-in::placeholder{color:#8b8574}
.gt-bar .gk-btn.gt-mode{min-width:3.4em;text-align:center}
.gt-bar[data-act] .gk-btn.gt-mode{background:#3a2f4a;color:#e6c8ff;box-shadow:0 -3px 0 0 #9b7bc4,0 3px 0 0 #9b7bc4,-3px 0 0 0 #9b7bc4,3px 0 0 0 #9b7bc4,0 6px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.gt-bar[data-act] .gt-in{font-style:italic}
.gt-in:focus,.gt-in:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:none}
/* 단추: 모서리를 한 칸 깎은 도트 단추 (kit의 메뉴 줄 판은 이 크기에서 찌그러진다) */
.gt-bar .gk-btn,.gt-bar .gk-btn:hover,.gt-bar .gk-btn:focus-visible{font-size:18px;line-height:1;padding:6px 10px;margin:0 3px;border:0;border-image:none;background:#2b2620;color:#d8d0bc;box-shadow:0 -3px 0 0 #6e6350,0 3px 0 0 #6e6350,-3px 0 0 0 #6e6350,3px 0 0 0 #6e6350,0 6px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.gt-bar .gk-btn:hover,.gt-bar .gk-btn:focus-visible{background:#3d3428;color:#ffe27a;box-shadow:0 -3px 0 0 #c9a74a,0 3px 0 0 #c9a74a,-3px 0 0 0 #c9a74a,3px 0 0 0 #c9a74a,0 6px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55);outline:none}
.gt-bar .gk-btn:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 -3px 0 0 #c9a74a,0 3px 0 0 #c9a74a,-3px 0 0 0 #c9a74a,3px 0 0 0 #c9a74a}
.gt-bar .gk-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
.gt-msg{flex-basis:100%;font-size:16px;color:#ff9a8a;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000}
.gt-msg:empty{display:none}
.gt-log{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:84px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(92%,720px);max-height:45%;overflow:auto;display:none;padding:4px 8px;pointer-events:auto;z-index:46;font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:#ece6d4;white-space:pre-wrap;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000}
.gt-log[data-open]{display:block}
`;
  function mountTalk(root, api, field) {
    ensureKit();
    const st = document.createElement("style");
    st.textContent = CSS2;
    const bar2 = document.createElement("div");
    bar2.className = "gt-bar gk-panel gk-font";
    bar2.setAttribute("role", "group");
    bar2.setAttribute("aria-label", "본부 대화");
    bar2.innerHTML = '<span class="gt-to"></span><button type="button" class="gk-btn gt-mode" data-mode aria-label="말로 보내기 (Tab: 행동으로 바꾸기)">말</button><input class="gt-in gk-slot gk-font" aria-label="할 말" placeholder="할 말" maxlength="300" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="send"><button type="button" class="gk-btn" data-send>말하기</button><button type="button" class="gk-btn" data-log>기록</button><button type="button" class="gk-btn" data-close aria-label="대화 닫기">닫기</button><div class="gt-msg" role="status"></div>';
    const log = document.createElement("div");
    log.className = "gt-log gk-panel gk-font";
    log.setAttribute("aria-label", "이번 대화 기록");
    root.append(st, bar2, log);
    const to = bar2.querySelector(".gt-to");
    const input = bar2.querySelector(".gt-in");
    const sendBtn = bar2.querySelector("[data-send]");
    const modeBtn = bar2.querySelector("[data-mode]");
    let act = false;
    const setMode = (on) => {
      act = on;
      bar2.toggleAttribute("data-act", on);
      modeBtn.textContent = on ? "행동" : "말";
      modeBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", on ? "행동으로 보내기 (Tab: 말로 바꾸기)" : "말로 보내기 (Tab: 행동으로 바꾸기)");
      input.placeholder = on ? "할 행동 (예: 서류를 건넨다)" : "할 말";
      input.setAttribute("aria-label", on ? "할 행동" : "할 말");
    };
    modeBtn.onclick = () => {
      setMode(!act);
      input.focus();
    };
    const msg = bar2.querySelector(".gt-msg");
    let state2 = { visitor: { agentId: "", name: "" }, agents: [], turns: [] };
    let target = "";
    let busy2 = false;
    let dead = false;
    const bubbles = [];
    const me = () => state2.visitor.name || "나";
    let seen2 = { people: [], player: null };
    const say = (who, text2, pending = false, delay = 0) => {
      for (let i = bubbles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (bubbles[i].who === who) bubbles.splice(i, 1);
      const from = performance.now() + delay;
      bubbles.push({ who, text: text2, pending, from, until: pending ? Infinity : from + 4e3 + [...text2].length * 80 });
    };
    const nearby = (target2) => {
      const p = seen2.player;
      if (!p) return [];
      return seen2.people.filter((q) => q.name !== target2 && Math.abs(q.x - p.x) < OVERHEAR).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.x - p.x) - Math.abs(b.x - p.x)).map((q) => state2.agents.find((a) => a.name === q.name && a.room)?.id ?? "").filter(Boolean);
    };
    const refresh = () => {
      sendBtn.disabled = busy2 || !target;
      input.disabled = busy2;
    };
    const renderLog = () => {
      const agent = state2.agents.find((a) => a.name === target);
      const turns = state2.turns.filter((t) => t.agentId === agent?.id || t.extra?.some((e) => e.agentId === agent?.id)).slice(-30);
      log.textContent = turns.length ? turns.map((t) => [t.act ? `${t.visitor || me()}: *${t.user}*` : `${t.visitor || me()}: ${t.user}`, `${t.name}: ${t.reply}`, ...(t.extra ?? []).map((e) => `${e.name}: ${e.line}`)].join("\n")).join("\n\n") : "아직 나눈 말이 없어요.";
      log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
    };
    async function open(name) {
      target = name;
      msg.textContent = "";
      to.textContent = `${name}에게`;
      bar2.setAttribute("data-open", "");
      refresh();
      if (typeof matchMedia === "undefined" || !matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) input.focus();
      try {
        state2 = await api.state();
        if (dead) return;
        if (!state2.agents.some((a) => a.name === name && a.room)) msg.textContent = "지금 이 요원과는 대화할 수 없어요.";
        if (log.hasAttribute("data-open")) renderLog();
      } catch (e) {
        if (!dead) msg.textContent = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      }
    }
    let exchanged = 0;
    function close() {
      if (target && exchanged > 0) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("goei:talk-closed", { detail: { name: target, exchanged } }));
      exchanged = 0;
      bar2.removeAttribute("data-open");
      log.removeAttribute("data-open");
      input.blur();
      target = "";
    }
    const followers = [];
    function follow(agent, text2) {
      if (!field || /^\*/.test(text2)) return;
      const want = classify(text2);
      if (want === "follow") {
        const ok = canJoin({ state: agent.state, affinity: 0 });
        if (!ok.ok) {
          msg.textContent = ok.reason ?? "";
          return;
        }
        if (followers.includes(agent.name)) return;
        followers.push(agent.name);
        const { shown, rest } = fieldCompanions(followers);

    o = { ...o, verb, room: room2 };

        wob.connect(g2.gain);
        osc(o, "sine", 0.05, t0, long, wob);
      } else {
        osc(o, "sine", l.f, t0, long, g2);
      }
    }
    const timers = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    const later = (f, ms) => {
      const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
        timers.delete(id);
        f();
      }, ms);
      timers.add(id);
    };
    let live = true;
    const fire = (e) => {
      if (!live) return;
      if (ctx.state !== "running") {
        later(() => fire(e), e.gap[0] * 1e3);
        return;
      }
      const vol = rnd2(e.vol[0], e.vol[1]);
      const pan = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (e.pan ?? 0);
      const pitch = e.pitch ? rnd2(e.pitch[0], e.pitch[1]) : 1;
      const t = ctx.currentTime + 0.05;
      if (e.id === "typing") {
        const n = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) oneShot(o, (ao) => SFX.switchClick.fn(ao, t + i * rnd2(0.07, 0.16), { vol: vol * rnd2(0.5, 1), pan, pitch: rnd2(1.2, 1.8), dest: out }));
      } else oneShot(o, (ao) => SFX[e.id].fn(ao, t, { vol, pan, pitch, dest: out }));
      later(() => fire(e), rnd2(e.gap[0], e.gap[1]) * 1e3);
    };
    for (const e of spec.events) later(() => fire(e), rnd2(e.gap[0] * 0.3, e.gap[1] * 0.6) * 1e3);
    return {

        if (!live) return;
        live = false;
        for (const id of timers) clearTimeout(id);
